title: I Work At The Mall World
content: It’s been a while since I’ve been back in the actual mall segment of the mall world. It seems like it’s bigger than it’s ever been. I got a job working at a high volume restaurant at the mall world. The people in charge found out about my background as a sound engineer and changed my job to being a DJ for parties. This was when some odd trouble arose. The staff at this “mall” was unified. Everyone wore the same black service uniforms, and it seemed like the entire enormous structure was not involved in retail, but was purely a function of recreation. It’s where… seemingly all humans go to party. On my first day as a DJ I got to wear whatever I wanted, so I wore an old pale t shirt that read simply “black people” over the left breast, with a huge number above it, almost like an ID number. I got separated from the people I carpooled with, and had absolutely no idea where I was supposed to go. I was passing a cop looking for the job when he squinted at my shirt and stopped me. “Whoa there, not cool.” He said, physically approaching me. I somehow *knew* that he had looked at my shirt and mistakenly read the number “187”, which is police code for murder in California. I backed up and was like “bro, read it again”. He squinted again and said “Oh”, and turned around to leave. I yelled after him “Yeah, I guess people just see what they want to see.” The problem was that I kept getting stopped by police for this reason. So I just took the shirt off. Now I’m running around topless with perpetually 5 minutes left to get to work, even though it’s getting dark outside. It is unbelievably crowded, and I keep getting the feeling I always get in the mall world, which is that **everyone is here.** I go through restaurants and bars. I go through a weird movie theater that’s not showing movies like we understand them, it’s some kind of alien format I don’t understand. I stepped on someone’s sneakers and gave them my phone number so I could pay them back. I was running inhumanly fast and I remember stepping on the sneakers and looking back at the person and thinking “shit, I should turn around, but I’m late and already so far away, they’ll never catch me.” I forced myself to turn around any way. I was in huge bar by a movie theater and I finally saw this weird nerdy looking staff member who was dressed in a full purple suit instead of the black clothes the rest of the staff wore. He was oddly eccentric and confident, interacting with both staff and customers in a charming manner. I wanted to ask him where my job was but I have a real aversion to inconveniencing service people sometimes and couldn’t bring myself to do it. I woke up soon after without ever finding the party. Backstory. This dream started out in a more lifelike format (not in the mall world). For some reason, I piloted a plane to Milwaukee Wisconsin, and the hotel I stayed at branched into the mall world, eventually all the way in California. The last time I was here in another dream I actually stayed past the “party” until sunrise. There were very few customers then, but there was still staff cleaning up. I remember I developed some kind of horrific mutated growth from my uvula, and as I was walking around pleading for help, only the janitorial staff would help me.
